elements.name: loft-07 Inspect alternative Loft path modes

steps.name: a disposable copy of the native fixture "fixtures/cad/loft/parallel-circles.opd" is open
the user creates a solid Loft1 by selecting both circular sketches as sections
Loft1 is open for editing in its default Rails mode
the second path mode is selected
the dialog requests a Center Line sketch and OK is disabled
the third path mode is selected
the dialog requests a Center Line and offers Placed Sections
the first mode is selected again
the Rails list and solid preview return
